beats.text: One country breaks the global pattern of male part-time work. It is not the expected one.
Is it the Netherlands, Ethiopia, or Somalia?
Part time employment in this series is based on a common definition of less than 35 actual weekly hours worked.
Malawi has 58.1%. Ethiopia has 56.2%. Somalia has 53.6%.
Ukraine has 100%. That is 250 times the value seen in Poland.
Poland is the world's lowest at 0.4%.
